title: Teller's name on a Project Sign/Grudge UFO review document

tellings.quote: there's a project sign or grudge document >> from pre-blue book >> in the late 40s and Edward Teller's name is on it where he's engaging in a real UFO review.

plain: The physicist Edward Teller, famous as a father of the hydrogen bomb, took part in a real government review of UFOs in the late 1940s, according to Michels. He says, without quoting it, that a document from Project Sign or Project Grudge, the US Air Force's early UFO studies before its better-known Blue Book study, has Teller's name on it. If so, it would mean top weapons scientists were brought into UFO questions from the very start.
